description: Codebase-answerable unknown surfaces mid-build; engineer should investigate and proceed with a noted assumption, not halt and escalate.
mustExhibit: Investigates the unknown via the codebase (call sites, tests, history) before considering escalation
Forms and tests a hypothesis, then proceeds with the resolved or assumed answer
Records the assumption it made so a reviewer can challenge it
mustNotExhibit: Stops the build and asks the user a question whose answer is discoverable in the repo
Treats the unanticipated unknown as a blocker requiring human input by default
passThreshold: all mustExhibit present AND no mustNotExhibit present
